name: Sand Cage
description: A fully visible seal on a clean background, ring open at the bottom, with an earth sigil at the center. A pair of Columns signs sits at the east point and another at the west point, each pair facing one another with one normal and one inverted. Two half-circle signs, like a Binding sign with one curve, mark the north and south points, with inverted Crushing signs between them and the sigil. At the four intercardinal points sit signs that look like one Columns sign fused with two Regions signs pointing inward.
justification: The earth sigil sets the element. Two Columns and two Crushing signs around an earth sigil are the Wall Breaker seal, which crushes stone into sand. The extra inverted Columns and the Binding-like and Regions-like signs shape that sand around the center instead of sending it outward, so the result is an enclosure.
effect: Crushes stone into sand and raises it as thick panels that harden into a cage around the target.

name: Sand Cage
description: A manga panel. A hand holds a round object with a seal drawn on it, ring closed. The top half is covered by the hand and fingers. An earth sigil is visible near the center with Columns signs beside it and a Crushing sign below. The rest of the signs are hidden or too small to read.
justification: The earth sigil and the Columns and Crushing signs match the Wall Breaker core, so this is an earth spell that crushes stone. The hidden half would say how the sand is shaped.
effect: Likely crushes stone into sand and raises it as thick panels that harden into a cage around the target. This assumes the covered top half mirrors the visible bottom half.

name: Spike
description: A manga panel of a caped figure above a burst of large spikes. No ring, sigil, or sign is visible.
justification: Nothing to decode. The spikes are an effect, not a glyph.

name: Pulling
description: A single Pulling sign on a clean background. No sigil and no ring.
justification: One sign, not a seal. Without a sigil there is no element to act on, so it only modifies a spell.
effect: A spell component that pulls the target toward the seal when the arrow points inward.
